name: Glass commit graph
oneLiner: a commit history on glass: the main line draws up with its commits, then each branch forks out and merges back in its own colour with the messages sliding in beside their dots, and a version tag stamps onto the newest commit
say: when the speaker talks about the work that went into a release ('weeks of commits', 'two branches, merged, and we shipped v1'): the branches draw while the speaker describes the work, the tag stamps on 'shipped' or the version name
